about: Drop-off and pickup facts for the ten case-study schools in scratch/2026-10-05-school-case-study-tool-plan.md. Built by scripts/school-dropoff.py; read note notes/school-trips-2026-10/2026-10-07-school-dropoff-research.md.
school_street_rule: Propose the block the main door faces; if it is an arterial or collector, propose the residential block where the school's own published drop-off happens; otherwise keep the door block at low confidence. [inference — mine]

schools.name: Bessie Carmichael School PreK-8 Filipino Education Center

door.how: EAS address point for 375 07TH ST (parcel 3754062, street CNN 373000); not checked against imagery
door.description: Main entrance mid-block on 7th Street, between Cleveland St and Harrison St, per SFMTA's 2025 walk audit.

other_doors.how: EAS address point for 824 HARRISON ST (parcel 3752012, street CNN 6719000); not checked against imagery
other_doors.label: 6-8 campus

schools.drop_off: Parent drop-off at the Sherman Street gate behind the PK-5 campus. Parents also use the passenger loading zone on 7th Street when the Sherman gate is closed. Staff and buses used 7th Street in the school's 2021 plan.
schools.loading_zone: Passenger loading zone on 7th Street next to a Muni stop (walk audit, 2025).
parent_rules: 2021 plan: "Staff and bus drop-off will be along 7th".

quotes.text: school entrance mid-block on 7th Street
Parents use this drop off if the Sherman Gate is closed
Drivers are confused where the turn lane begins and the passenger loading zone / Muni Bus stop ends
Vehicles speeding and cut through on Sherman and Cleveland Streets

PK and TK parent drop-off along Sherman St, K-5 parent drop-off will be dropped off on a different part of Sherman St. Staff and bus drop-off will be along 7th, staff will have an alternative entry along Harrison St.
Monday: 9:30 am-3:45 pm
Wednesday: 9:30 am-2:30 pm

school_street.why: 7th Street is a collector with a bikeway, a Muni stop and the loading zone, so the proposal is the residential pair behind the school where parents already drop off: Sherman St from Cleveland to Harrison, and Cleveland St from Sherman to 7th, which the walk audit names for cut-through traffic.

schools.confidence_why: The drop-off street comes from a 2021 plan and a 2025 SFMTA walk audit, not from a current school page.
gaps: The school's current pages give hours but say nothing about drop-off.
The 6-8 campus at 824 Harrison St has no published drop-off; Harrison is an arterial, and no side street is proposed for it.

door.how: EAS address point for 1060 KEY AVE (parcel 4994002, street CNN 7819000); not checked against imagery
door.description: Address point on Key Ave between Jennings St and 3rd St. The school page says students are "greeted at the entrance" but does not say which street it is on.

schools.drop_off: Not published on the school's page.

quotes.text: Regular School Day 8:00am-3:00pm
Wednesday School Day 8:00am-2:30pm
All students are greeted at the entrance, and free breakfast is available.

school_street.why: Key Ave between Jennings St and 3rd St is a residential block and the school's address street. 3rd St, at the east end, carries the T line and is not a closure candidate.

schools.confidence_why: The door is the address point, not seen on imagery, and a renovation that moves the entrance may be under way.
gaps: A campus renovation page, bayview.kippnorcal.org/renovation/, appeared in a web search on 2026-10-07 describing "a new main entrance" and "safer drop off and loading zones". It now redirects to the school page, so the text could not be read [web search — verify].
The crash count times its drop-off and pick-up hours from default bells of 8:15 and 3:15. The school's own bells are 8:00 and 3:00.

schools.name: The International School of San Francisco (Oak campus)
schools.repo_name: The International School of San Francisco

door.how: EAS address point for 150 OAK ST (parcel 0833003, street CNN 9751000); not checked against imagery
door.description: Address point on Oak St between Franklin St and Gough St. The school's 2015 traffic letter puts the car line on Hickory St, the alley behind.

schools.drop_off: A car line that enters Hickory St from the left lane of Gough St. No double parking on Oak St, and no parking in front of the gym during morning drop-off, 7:30 to 8:30.

bell.note: Lower and middle school childcare runs "7:30 a.m. to 8:00 a.m. and 3:30 p.m. to 6 p.m.", which brackets the day; the school day itself is not stated.

parent_rules: Double parking in the left and right lanes of Oak Street is prohibited.
Parking is prohibited during morning dropoff (7:30-8:30) in front of the Gym.
"Cutting in" the line in the left lane of Gough Street (turning in to Hickory Alley) is prohibited.
Do not park on the north side curb on Hickory.

quotes.text: our school is bounded by four busy intersections and parking is limited.
Double parking in the left and right lanes of Oak Street is prohibited. Parking is prohibited during morning dropoff (7:30-8:30) in front of the Gym.
“Cutting in” the line in the left lane of Gough Street (turning in to Hickory Alley) is prohibited. Please proceed around the block and enter the line at the rear.
Crossing Gough Street with children in MID-BLOCK (at Hickory) is illegal and unsafe!
Simply park and walk to the building to pick up.
The new high school will have a welcoming, separate entrance to the campus
Our goal is for construction to be completed by the end of the 2026 calendar year .
Childcare and special after school activities are available for an additional fee from 7:30 a.m. to 8:00 a.m. and 3:30 p.m. to 6 p.m.

school_street.why: Oak St is an arterial, so the proposal is Hickory St from Franklin to Gough, the alley where the school's car line already runs.

schools.confidence_why: The car-line rules are from a 2015 letter still on the school's site, and the campus is under construction until the end of 2026 with a new high school entrance.
gaps: No current (2026-27) drop-off page was found; the newest rules are the 2015 letter.
Bell times are not published on the pages read.

after_school.endQuote: Childcare is available until 6:00 p.m. daily on Oak Street and Page Street.

door.description: Address point for 221 Main St between Howard St and East Tehama St. The school moved from 973 Mission St; the old site's address point is kept as old_door.

other_doors.how: EAS address point for 973 MISSION ST (parcel 3725078, street CNN 9099000); not checked against imagery
other_doors.label: old_door (973 Mission St, where the crash count was measured)

schools.drop_off: Not published. The school's profile says most students commute by transit for long distances.

quotes.text: 221 Main St, STE 104 San Francisco, CA 94105
Most students commute 1–3 hours per day, round trip, to attend school.

school_street.why: Main St between Howard St and East Tehama St is the new address block and is classed residential in 3psu-pn9h.

gaps: The case study's crash ranking needs rerunning at 221 Main St before Proof stays on the list.
Whether Main St on this block is one-way multi-lane traffic to the Bay Bridge is not checked [model knowledge — verify]; the centerline gives it one-way flag T.

door.how: EAS address point for 1387 VALENCIA ST (parcel 6515037, street CNN 13073000); not checked against imagery
door.description: Address point on the east side of Valencia St between 24th and 25th, about 140 ft from 25th. The school's history page says the front of the 1920s building, "with its ornate entryway", was kept.

schools.drop_off: Not published on the pages read.

quotes.text: School Hours 8:30 AM – 3:00 PM 8:30 AM – 2:10 PM Wednesdays
the front portion of the old building was kept intact with its ornate entryway and original tile. In place of two parking lots on either side of the building, play yards were created.

school_street.why: Valencia St between 24th and 25th is the door block and is classed residential in 3psu-pn9h.

schools.confidence_why: No drop-off is published, the door is the address point, and Valencia is a commercial street with a bikeway, which makes a closure there a larger ask than a side street [model knowledge — verify]. 25th St from Orange Alley to Valencia (CNN 1444000, 166 ft) is the nearest side block.
gaps: A 2020-21 reopening plan with drop-off rules is listed in search results, but the page now returns 404.

schools.name: Lycée Français de San Francisco, Ortega campus

door.how: EAS address point for 1201 ORTEGA ST (parcel 2115037, street CNN 10007000); not checked against imagery
door.description: Address point at Ortega St and 19th Ave, on the 1200 block between 19th and 20th Ave.

schools.drop_off: Not published on the public site; dismissal and check-in run through a parents-only app. The school runs shuttles from Marin and Cupertino to this campus.

bell.note: Doors open at 7:45 am. No dismissal time is published for Ortega; the Ashbury and Sausalito campuses' 3:15 pm does not apply to it.

quotes.text: The Ortega campus welcomes students as early as 7:45 am. Bell rings and class starts at 8:10 am.
Our daily student transportation program facilitates the morning and afternoon commute of our students to and in between our 3 campuses.
Dismissal, check-in, absences and messages — the school's family platform, all in one place.

school_street.why: Ortega St between 19th and 20th Ave is the door block and residential. 19th Ave, at the east end, is State Route 1 and stays open.

schools.confidence_why: The address and block are clear; where cars and shuttles stop is not published.
gaps: Dismissal time and drop-off location sit behind the parent login.
The shuttle route PDF (Google Drive link on the campuses page) was not opened.

sources.title: Lycée Français de San Francisco, Admissions FAQs (School hours on Ortega)

after_school.note: The school lists after-school care for its Ashbury and Sausalito campuses only.
